headline: Excluded pilot: not a valid controlled comparison
summary: The shared contract listed allthree application requirements. Multiple generators implemented the whole suite, so work allocation differed. This entire cohort is excluded from the adoption decision.
recommendation: Use the corrected task-only cohort in controlled/. Do not adopt or reject the experimental skill based on this pilot.
limitations: Whole-cohort harness error; outputs retained without quality selection.
Three early jobs also needed quota recovery; hidden context could not be restored.
Early anonymous notes are retained as pilot observations only, not primary results.
